summary: The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of the value of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from mining, production, development, or exploration of silver; and publicly traded closed-end trusts that invest 50% or more of their assets in physical silver. The fund is non-diversified.
